topic.title: Does a UPI payment above ₹2,000 at a shop now cost the customer extra

cta: Has a shop refused your UPI?
title: Shopkeeper says UPI above ₹2,000 costs extra? Here is who really pays
description: The talk at the counter: pay by UPI above ₹2,000 and you pay a fee. The proposed 0.4% merchant fee is charged to the shop, not you, and it has been put off until after Diwali. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
